answer: One workable design: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because wander only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. In practice quill is enforced by the ledger itself: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any gale approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
